Commentary.Commentary: Time for the run chase!
... RUN CHASE ...

Bangladesh bowled decently but their fielding is what let them down a little. Both the openers were dropped and Verma made Bangladesh pay. They though did well to pull things back towards the end but still their batters face a tough task ahead. India on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

A brilliant last over from Marufa Akter has kept India to below 150 but we believe the visitors have a score which is slightly over par. They lost Mandhana early but Shafali Verma batted in an attacking manner and got them off to a very good start. Kaur and Bhatia too got off to starts and when the two were batting, 150 looked easy but wickets towards the end has seen India fall below that.
OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket to end. Just two runs and two wickets in the final over! Top stuff! On middle. This is lifted towards towards long on and the fielder takes it. India end with 145!

We welcome you to the coverage of the first out of the five T20Is between Bangladesh and India. Without a doubt the Indians are heavy favourites but Bangladesh in Bangladesh are a side which can't be taken lightly. The last time the Indians visited, there were a lot of close encounters and we expect nothing different. Will we see the hosts upset the odds or will India prove to be too strong for them? We will find out. Toss and teams in a bit.
.... MATCH DAY ...

Women's cricketing action returns with a bang as Bangladesh Women play host to India Women for an enthralling 5-match T20I series, set to unfold at the prestigious Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. In their last bilateral encounter, India Women emerged victorious in the three-match T20I series with a 2-1 triumph, while the 3-match ODI series ended in a tantalizing deadlock, with one win apiece and a thrilling tied decider. This series presents a golden opportunity for both teams to fine-tune their squads and adapt to the conditions ahead of the forthcoming Asia Cup and T20 World Cup, scheduled to be held in Bangladesh later this year. India Women hold a dominant record over their Asian counterparts, having emerged triumphant in 14 out of the 17 encounters between the two sides. However, Bangladesh Women have shown their grit and competitiveness in recent encounters and will be eager to upset the odds and make their mark. The India Women's team arrives on the back of an exhilarating second edition of the Women's T20 League, with captain Harmanpreet Kaur leading the charge to ensure a strong performance. With star players like Smriti Mandhana, fresh off a Women’s T20 League title win with Bengaluru, expected to play a pivotal role, India Women aim to maintain their supremacy despite missing the services of Jemimah Rodrigues due to a back injury. Additionally, debutants Sajeevan Sajana and Asha Sobhana, who impressed during the Women's T20 League, will be eager to leave their mark on the international stage. On the opposing side, Bangladesh Women, under the leadership of Nigar Sultana and vice-captain Nahida Akter, will be bolstered by the inclusion of 15-year-old pace sensation Habiba Pinky in their ranks. With players like Murshida Khatun and Fahima Khatun, Bangladesh will aim to harness their talent and put up a spirited challenge against the formidable Indian squad. With both teams vying for supremacy and a lot at stake, this series promises to be a fiercely contested affair, characterized by intense competition and thrilling cricketing action.
